plugins.name: software-team
plugins.description: 软件开发团队：按风险编排需求、设计、实现、审查与 QA；提供快速模式、BugFix、整改、标准开发和上线前审查。PR 粒度与模板遵循目标仓库规范；依赖/API 升级时评估上游能力与下游简化机会。

description_i18n.zh-CN: 软件开发团队：按风险编排需求、设计、实现、审查与 QA；提供快速模式、BugFix、整改、标准开发和上线前审查。PR 粒度与模板遵循目标仓库规范；依赖/API 升级时评估上游能力与下游简化机会。
description_i18n.en: Software team orchestrated by risk-based workflows for planning, implementation, review and QA. Supports fast delivery, bug fixes, remediation, standard development and release review. PR scope and templates follow repository conventions; dependency/API upgrades assess upstream capabilities and downstream simplification.

plugins.name: qa-team
plugins.description: 质量保障团队：编排测试策略、API/UI 执行与独立复核，覆盖接口回归、E2E、安全与发版门禁；按变更选择最小充分回归，依赖/API 替换纳入受影响调用路径验证。

description_i18n.zh-CN: 质量保障团队：编排测试策略、API/UI 执行与独立复核，覆盖接口回归、E2E、安全与发版门禁；按变更选择最小充分回归，依赖/API 替换纳入受影响调用路径验证。
description_i18n.en: QA team orchestrating risk-based test design, API/UI execution and independent review for regression, E2E, security and release gates. Selects minimum-sufficient coverage by change; dependency/API replacements include affected call paths.
